count_rule: Refuse to invent countable dollars; promote only evidence-backed incremental reserved cash. COUNTABLE NOW = demonstrated incremental reserved cash only.

engine_feeder_scores.rationale: Fuel ~$572M is real and highway-earmarked. Stack Use envelopes imply incremental redesign that is still unmodeled — demote to thin research ceiling until a free incremental use stream is designed and reserved.

Gas/oil severance real but mostly highway-dedicated / volatile. Lithium public-share remains post-2028 design — not cash. Demote Acc $250M; keep thin research ceiling for early public-share path.

engine_feeder_scores.next_evidence: Incremental visitor/luxury mechanism with reserved cash (not marketing raid)

engine_feeder_scores.rationale: Swing variable: outside demand is real; public capture mechanisms are not. Acc $1B and Base $400M assume ownership/participation that does not exist. engine_feeder_scores.rationale: Corpus math is honest; fund does not exist; feeders are illustrative. Acc $1B payout implies transformational External Income / participation feeders that failed hard-wall this pass. Soft-hold Base only as conditional research (well below T250) until feeders bind.

engine_feeder_scores.rationale: Effective-base haircut (~57% → ~$27.7B; 1%≈$277M) is the honest research ceiling. Acc 1.5% assumes legal/admin clearance not earned. Cap Acc at Base 1% until constitutional lane clears. Still $0 countable — not enacted.

evidence_grounded_illustrative_ceilings_.note: Not countable. Soft ceilings after demoting envelopes that lack bound mechanisms. Still ILLUSTRATIVE_NOT_COUNTED.

vision_test_after_feeder_binding.reading: Evidence demotion shrinks Accelerated fantasy most (External Income + Fund). Dual abolition still fails. Many small mechanisms remain the end-state architecture — but most still lack feeders.

Dual abolition still fails after demotion — demoted Acc ceiling still << $7.23B
